ta_read.text: QQQ's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Oct 30, when it closed below $701.16. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show mixed swings (a range).

Price is inside a zone at $659.70–$663.84 where it turned 2 times, most recently on Jul 29; the nearest support zone is $644.98–$649.12, where price turned 1 times, most recently on Nov 5; the nearest resistance zone is $684.90–$693.76, where price turned 3 times, most recently on Jul 17.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-2.7%) came on light volume.
RSI is 38 (neutral); MACD is below its signal line since Oct 13.
A daily close above $693.76 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $644.98 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.

ai_note.subject: QQQ
ai_note.text: The committee says Reduce with medium conviction: swings are lower highs and lower lows, the weekly trend is down, and the structure broke down on Oct 30 below 701.16. There were 8 distribution days against 4 accumulation days, RSI is 38, and MACD has been below its signal line since Oct 13. The market table shows QQQ at 661.75 after a 2.7% fall, so it is already between the 659.70 to 663.84 zone and the 644.98 to 649.12 support. A close below 644.98, which is also near the 1-month low of 647.05, would confirm weakness. A close above 693.76 with a business grade of B or better would change the committee's mind. My opinion is that the lean is down.
